long_notes:
Hey everyone! I have a pretty big update today! Let me break it down for you:

Things I Added: 

• The option to save chat messages on xAI’s servers instead of your device and continue them via previous_response_id! This option lets you save storage and improve cost efficiency, with the only major trade-off being that chats saved online are only able to be continued for up to 30 days.

• The usage data for each chat now tracks how many server-side tools Grok calls throughout the chat, so you can see all the tools Grok uses!

Things I Removed:

• The experimental Grok 4.20 models, as they have become obsolete.

• Trimming chats and custom system messages, because they are both not really useful and impossible to implement with storing messages online.

Things I Fixed:

• Numerous bugs

• The Grok 4.20 model names

I hope you all enjoy this massive update!
